topics.topic: INV-06 recovery test behavior when an A6 rule 5 refusal condition follows the failed write
questions: Must the INV-06 recovery test show completion only when no A6 rule 5 refusal applies, or must a retry after the failed record write complete even when such a refusal condition is present?
Must this test require completion only when no A6 rule 5 refusal applies, and what must it assert when the failed write is followed by a damaged record?
Must this Required tests item explicitly exclude every A6 rule 5 refusal, or must it instead demonstrate the newly added refusal branch as well as successful recovery?

quotes:
After condition 5 a stored image may remain without a record: no caller has received
   its reference, and a repeated delivery of the same file writes it again and completes the placement,
   unless a refusal of A6 rule 5 applies.
A delivery repeated after a failed record write completes the placement (`test_a_delivery_repeated_after_a_failed_record_write_completes`).
judgement.divergence: The retry is refused when an A6 rule 5 condition applies, or it completes unconditionally; the caller and an inspector of durable placement state notice.
judgement.why: The Required tests sentence promises unconditional completion while the normative recovery rule expressly excepts retries to which A6 rule 5 applies.

   record: the operation is refused with the STATE_UNAVAILABLE member of = models.RefusalCode, whose value is
   `state_unavailable`, and changes no record and no stored image.
